title: The test procedure of a commissioning: how the factory reads one
note: The format of the station's test procedures, as the procedure factory reads it (2026-09-28: no domain in the harness). The guard's rules are not here: they are the signed document's (rulesDocument). The executor reads the procedure as tier3/procedure.ts says; readers says what it can read to stop a test.

readers.co2: scrubber.motor.state: the CO2 of the volume, at or above limits.co2AbortPpm
readers.refused: scrubber.motor.set_speed: the device refused a step's command
readers.battery: station.registry_list: the battery's state of charge under threshold percent (the card's minimum when absent)
readers.vitals: biomed.verdict: a monitored person out of their band, the monitoring lost, or one more person in the volume under test
